title: Triconex Key Switch in PROGRAM Mode

fields.headline: SIS Controller Key Switch in PROGRAM Mode
fields.narration: Operations Supervisor enters the Control Room and confirms the Triconex key switch on TRI-1 is in PROGRAM mode. The switch was not in this position at 09:00, and no one on shift has authorized a change. The SIS is not in a safe operating state. The OT Engineer must now validate the controller’s status and isolate the SIS segment immediately.
keyFacts: Triconex key switch on TRI-1 is in PROGRAM mode.
No operator on shift made this change.
SIS is not in RUN or MANUAL mode.
No log entry exists for the switch change.
The SIS must be isolated at FW-SIS and TS-EWS-01 disconnected from the network.
fields.expectedAction: IC orders the OT Engineer to immediately isolate the SIS segment at FW-SIS and disconnect TS-EWS-01 from the network; the OT Engineer confirms the switch position and logs it for forensic review.
fields.facilitatorNote: Pause after 'not in this position' to let the weight sink in. The switch state is a critical forensic indicator.
fields.scenarioTitle: Ghost Line — Chlorine Release at Rail Spot 2

instructorNote: This inject confirms the cyber intrusion: the key switch in PROGRAM mode is a hallmark of the TRITON/TRISIS attack pattern. The OT Engineer must now follow C1, step 2 and C2, step 4.
